hook: Their sailboat was half sunk with an 8-year-old aboard.
narration: Their sailboat was half underwater, with an eight year old aboard.
The family was in a life raft beside it.
A Jayhawk crew from Air Station Clearwater flew out and lowered the rescue basket.
The hoist operator guides the basket in by hand from the open door.
[short pause] The child and both adults rode it up into the helicopter.
outcome: All three reached Bahamian authorities in Great Inagua, and no injuries were reported.
title: Half-sunk sailboat, 8-year-old aboard
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater aircrew rescued an 8-year-old child and two adults from a life raft after their sailboat became partially submerged near Plana Cays, Bahamas, on June 30, 2025.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, U.S. Coast Guard Southeast, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/968601/coast-guard-rescues-family-partially-submerged-vessel-near-plana-cays-bahamas

located the family aboard a life raft.
